source_snapshot.procedure: Enable the BMC SNMPv3 agent and user through Web UI, load MIB files in iReasoning MIB Browser, configure matching SNMPv3 access and use Get Next/Get Subtree on `$target`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Use Net-SNMP: enable the same BMC SNMPv3 settings, install MIB files and use get-type commands to retrieve `$target` values.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek substitutes an assumed insecure Redfish request for the SNMP test and leaves the vendor MIB root/object set, SNMPv3 credentials/security and completeness contract undefined.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the BMC's owner-designated Standard Equipment MIB objects are reachable through an authorized SNMPv3 account, decode according to the approved MIB and return the complete/correct BMC equipment values for the finite `$target` object set.
original_test_intent.target: The exact vendor/standard-equipment MIB module and owner-supplied numeric OID subtree/object instances represented by `$target`, queried from an isolated management host against the selected BMC SNMPv3 agent.
original_test_intent.scope: Configure SNMPv3 agent/user access, resolve and query a bounded read-only object set with iReasoning and/or Net-SNMP as the owner specifies, validate type/index/value/completeness, then restore the prior agent/account state. Redfish is not equivalent evidence unless separately requested as a cross-check.
original_test_intent.operation: Record current BMC SNMP configuration, obtain approval, enable only the approved SNMPv3 agent/user/ACL, validate the MIB and numeric OID map offline, query the finite target with GET/GETNEXT/bounded WALK using secured credential handling, compare decoded and numeric outputs with owner truth, collect audit/health evidence and restore or retain the configuration exactly as approved.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One bounded retrieval for every approved target object/instance with each required client path; no trap, SET or repeated stress loop is specified.
original_test_intent.expected_result: SNMPv3 authentication/privacy and VACM access succeed only for the approved user/source/object range; every required OID instance returns the expected syntax/type/value or documented dynamic tolerance; no required or extra instance is missed; BMC health remains normal and temporary configuration is removed/restored.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: BMC/firmware and MIB version/hash, redacted before/after SNMPv3 agent/user/ACL state, management-host/tool versions, finite symbolic/numeric OID-instance map with access/type/expected rule, bounded raw numeric and decoded results, client-equivalence decision, BMC audit/health and cleanup proof.
ambiguities: `$target` is unresolved and no finite OID/object/instance or equipment-category list is supplied.
The source does not say whether iReasoning and Net-SNMP are both required or alternative clients.
No object-specific expected values, dynamic tolerances, indexes, completeness rule or post-test SNMP configuration state is defined.
DeepSeek's Redfish replacement changes the protocol under test and cannot establish SNMPv3/MIB behavior.
source_conflicts: The procedure mandates iReasoning MIB Browser while the criteria says to use Net-SNMP; the owner must state whether both clients must agree or one is the acceptance path.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects the Redfish substitution and requires bounded OIDs, SNMPv3 security, MIB semantics and cleanup. It overstates missing target/object/schema inputs as permanent technical BLOCKED; the SNMP test purpose and setup/query/restore workflow are clear, and those items are provisionable inputs plus an owner client-choice decision.

applicable_history.decision: The historical review treats the case as partial and suggests Redfish as alternate evidence, but does not preserve SNMP as the protocol under test or resolve `$target`.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. Bounded SNMPv3 retrieval/comparison is technically automatable after vendor MIB/OID and secure account inputs; human-approved BMC configuration and client-path decision remain readiness gates.

available_now: The protocol, execution locations and core action are clear: SNMPv3 reads from an external management host after BMC agent/account setup.
BMC capability/current redacted SNMP configuration and management-host tool readiness can be inventoried before enabling anything.
Net-SNMP officially distinguishes GET, GETNEXT/WALK and SET; SNMPv3 provides user/security-level and VACM controls, so a read-only bounded query plan is implementable.
missing_inputs: Vendor/standard-equipment MIB file/version/hash and a finite `$target` symbolic/numeric OID-instance list with syntax/access/index/completeness/expected-value rules
Decision whether iReasoning, Net-SNMP or both are required and how outputs are compared
BMC WebUI setup/restore procedure, approved SNMPv3 user/security protocols/level, VACM view, source ACL, isolated management host and secret-custody method
Temporary-versus-persistent configuration decision, redaction policy, BMC query-rate limit and health/abort thresholds
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/SNMP owner supplies the MIB/OID/value contract and setup procedure; the test owner resolves client acceptance; security/network owners approve SNMPv3 credentials, algorithms, VACM/ACL and host; the lab owner approves state change and cleanup.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Inventory BMC firmware/SNMP capability and current redacted agent/user/ACL state without enabling or altering it; inspect management-host Net-SNMP/iReasoning versions
Validate MIB syntax/hash and translate candidate symbolic objects to numeric OIDs offline; prepare bounded query and redaction plans without sending credentials or requests
prohibited_until_closed: Do not enable SNMP, create/modify users, query an unspecified root, run SET, use v1/v2c community fallback, place secrets on command lines/evidence or run DeepSeek's Redfish substitute
Do not use an unbounded WALK, assume a hard-coded Redfish URI, bypass TLS for any optional cross-check, collect unauthorized serial/topology data or leave temporary access enabled
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The signed object manifest is finite and resolves to numeric OIDs; MIB parser output and access types are verified; SNMPv3 auth/privacy/VACM/ACL configuration is least-privilege and secret-safe; client acceptance and cleanup are explicit; a dry query plan proves bounds and expected instance counts.

revision_candidate.test_name: BMC Standard Equipment MIB Data over SNMPv3
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify a finite owner-approved Standard Equipment MIB object set is securely readable from the BMC through SNMPv3 and returns complete, correctly typed and expected values.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact BMC firmware and vendor MIB release, an isolated authorized management host with approved Net-SNMP and/or iReasoning client, least-privilege SNMPv3 user/VACM/ACL and a documented setup/restore path.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the signed `$target` numeric OID subtrees/object instances and required equipment fields. Redfish is out of scope unless an explicit mapped cross-check is added; SNMP SET and traps are out of scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: MIB file/hash/version; finite symbolic/numeric OID-instance manifest; syntax/access/index and expected/dynamic-value/completeness rules; client-path decision; SNMPv3 auth/privacy/VACM/ACL and secret handling; BMC procedure; query limits; approval and cleanup state.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture redacted baseline; after approval configure the least-privilege SNMPv3 agent/user/view/source ACL; validate MIB translation; execute only bounded GET/GETNEXT/WALK queries for the manifest; retain numeric and decoded output; compare types/instances/values; inspect audit/health; restore or retain configuration exactly as approved.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct BMC/MIB/manifest selected; all target objects read-only; expected values/instance counts defined; isolated host and approved clients ready; credentials injected through a protected channel; rate/bounds/abort and cleanup defined; owner approval active; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: BMC/MIB/client identifiers; signed OID manifest; redacted SNMPv3 security/VACM/ACL before/during/after; complete bounded numeric and decoded results with return status/timestamps; type/index/value/completeness comparison; BMC audit/health and cleanup proof.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact owner/vendor Standard Equipment MIB and platform equipment inventory/value contract, with Net-SNMP behavior used only for query mechanics and not as the source of expected BMC data.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never use SET, v1/v2c fallback, unbounded roots, plaintext secrets, unauthorized OIDs, assumed Redfish substitutes, TLS bypass, excessive query rate or persistent temporary access.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BMC/security owner approves agent/user/VACM/ACL changes and secret handling; test owner approves target manifest and client acceptance. Read-only queries can run automatically only inside those bounds.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: WebUI account/agent setup may require an operator; owners decide schema/value exceptions and cleanup state. MIB validation, bounded retrieval, comparison and health evidence can be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On authentication/VACM mismatch, unexpected writable object, out-of-scope instance, sensitive output, BMC load/health issue or failed cleanup, stop queries, revoke/disable temporary access through the approved path, preserve redacted audit evidence and do not broaden permissions for retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved `$target`/client path, invalid MIB, non-read-only object, undefined expected/instance count, insecure or exposed credentials, missing approval/ACL, out-of-bound response, repeated timeout/BMC degradation, unauthorized sensitive data or failed configuration restoration.

identified_defects: V2 converts missing provisionable MIB/OID/value and client-choice inputs into automation BLOCKED even though the SNMPv3 purpose is clear.
DeepSeek replaces the protocol under test with an assumed insecure Redfish request and malformed completeness text.
The source conflicts on iReasoning versus Net-SNMP and leaves `$target` unresolved.
reason_for_change: Missing MIB files, target OIDs, secure credentials and an operator setup decision are supplyable execution conditions; they must prevent execution/PASS now without claiming the read-only SNMP workflow is technically impossible to automate.

new_technical_evidence.title: Net-SNMP Command Tutorials
new_technical_evidence.version: Net-SNMP 5.x documentation; installed version must be recorded
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Net-SNMP client mechanics on the approved management host
new_technical_evidence.supports: GET, GETNEXT/WALK and SET are distinct operations; the test can be bounded to read retrieval without any SET.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The vendor MIB, exact objects and BMC implementation are owner/platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Net-SNMP SNMPv3 Options
new_technical_evidence.supports: SNMPv3 uses user-based security and VACM authorization with defined security levels, including authenticated/encrypted authPriv operation.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Approved algorithms, credentials, views and BMC capabilities must come from the security/platform owner.

removed_ambiguities: Preserves SNMP as the protocol under test and rejects Redfish as a substitute.
Separates owner client-path choice from technical ability to run bounded reads.
Defines a finite OID manifest and post-test access cleanup as completion prerequisites.
resolved_blockers: The protocol and intended operation are clear; absent MIB/OID/security inputs are provisionable and therefore no longer justify automation_classification=BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: No BMC configuration or SNMP query until the finite target/value contract, client path, secure account/VACM/ACL, approval and cleanup plan are closed.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains V2's secure bounded-query safeguards and current execution prohibition while correcting the capability classification and exposing useful offline/read-only pre-work instead of treating missing MIB inputs as permanent impossibility.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator retained a finite signed Standard Equipment MIB manifest, SNMPv3 type/index/value/completeness evidence and did not substitute Redfish.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source enables BMC SNMPv3/user settings, loads MIB files and retrieves `$target` through iReasoning and/or Net-SNMP.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly rejects unsafe Redfish substitution but treats missing finite OIDs and setup inputs as capability BLOCKED rather than readiness gates.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow only offline MIB translation and current-state inventory before closure; require least-privilege authPriv/VACM/ACL, bounded read-only OIDs, secret redaction and verified cleanup, with no SET or protocol substitution.
